description: An environment variable's `value` is a secret (variables default to `type=secret`) (https://www.tinybird.co/docs/api-reference/environment-variables-api). PUT /v0/variables/(.+) has no parameter table; its example sends `-d "value=new_value"`. Live: POST /v0/variables?name=...&value=... and PUT /v0/variables/<name>?value=... both answered 200, and no response carries the value.
